flags.adu: There is a proposed rule (not yet law) that would allow up to 2 accessory dwelling units by right on parcels zoned RM-M, with size and height limits, but this is still pending in Council [zoning.district, reform.status].

flags.gap-financing: This parcel is in an area with a low median assessed land value, so gap financing (extra funding to cover a shortfall) may be needed; this is only a note, not a penalty to the score [hood.median_land_psf].
flags.phfa-infill: Because this is a vacant lot in a low-value area, it may qualify for infill or blight-related scoring under PHFA programs, but you should confirm this against current PHFA criteria [landuse.vacant, hood.median_land_psf].
flags.public-owner: This parcel is owned by the City, which may make acquisition easier through a public disposition process, though this is not guaranteed [owner.type].
